authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high photorealism in textures (stone, cobblestone, metal) and lighting. However, it contains definitive AI artifacts: license plates display nonsensical character strings ('H L-6 00 O', 'R X BK AG WP'), and the cars at the extreme frame edges exhibit structural fusion and unnatural cropping. While the penguin lacks biological King Penguin coloration (orange/black/white), this aligns with the 'stone penguin' prompt modifier rather than representing a generation failure. The primary authenticity deductions stem from text gibberish and edge-case structural anomalies.
